title: heleniastrum elegans
intro: Heleniastrum elegans, commonly known as Helianthus annuus, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Heleniastrum elegans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. These constituents may help to protect against cell damage, modulate immune responses, and exhibit anti-cancer properties, making Heleniastrum elegans a subject of interest in modern pharmacology.
